text:
Our field sales team piloted an AI note-taker for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**The wins:**
Reps reclaimed about five hours a week previously spent on CRM updates. Follow-up emails went out same-day instead of two days later. Managers finally saw what buyers actually said, not a rep's summary.

**The surprises:**
Adoption hinged on trust. Reps who feared "surveillance" resisted until we made recordings private by default and shared only summaries.

Accuracy dipped in noisy plants and parking-lot calls, so we kept a quick manual check.

**The takeaway:**
The tool didn't improve selling. It removed admin so reps could focus on it.

Next quarter: we're tying note insights to deal reviews.

What has your team learned from AI pilots?
